# spectral.voigt_two_linear_known { #clerq.spectral.voigt_two_linear_known }

```python
spectral.voigt_two_linear_known(freq_list, decay_rate, thermal_width)
```

Returns the Voigt profile for a two-level system in the linear regime.

The Voigt profile is the convolution of a Lorentzian with a Gaussian, and
describes the absorption lineshape for a thermal two-level system.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                            | Default    |
|---------------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| freq_list     | np.ndarray | List of frequency detunings from resonance (in 2pi Gamma).                                                                                                             | _required_ |
| decay_rate    | float      | Spontaneous decay rate of the transition (in 2pi Gamma).                                                                                                               | _required_ |
| thermal_width | float      | Doppler width, in the same units as decay rate (in 2pi Gamma): the Gaussian is ``exp(-(freq / thermal_width)**2)``, so its FWHM is ``2 * sqrt(ln 2) * thermal_width``. | _required_ |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}
